name: jared
description: Work through a code review of a file or a diff, exported from Jared, the line-by-line review app

jared_url.title: Where Jared runs
jared_url.description: The address of a Jared that runs somewhere already. Leave it empty to use the copy of Jared that this plugin carries, which needs nothing else to run. Set it only for a Jared that you run yourself or trust: the plugin opens your file there, and the page at that address receives it. This works for a file of up to about 75 KB.

submit_label.title: Words on Jared's review button
submit_label.description: What Jared calls the button that hands the review back to Claude (1 to 40 characters). The default is Submit review.
